programs.name: Ball Control Basics
programs.description: Develop ball touches and coordination with fun progressions.

programs.name: Small-Sided Games
programs.description: Learn positioning and decision-making through 3v3 and 4v4.

programs.name: Shooting & Finishing
programs.description: Finishing techniques: 1v1 decisions, placement and power.

programs.name: Passing & Movement
programs.description: Passing patterns and moving off the ball to create space.

programs.name: Recovery & Mobility
programs.description: Recovery routines, mobility and injury prevention for young athletes.

programs.name: U17 Elite: Attacking Shape
programs.description: Developing chemistry between midfield and forwards, set piece execution, and advanced combination play.

programs.name: Goalkeeping: Foundation
programs.description: Covers basic diving, catching technique, distribution skills (hands and feet), and commanding the box.

programs.name: Goalkeeping: Advanced
programs.description: Focuses on shot stopping, penalty saves, dealing with crosses, and advanced communication with the back line.

programs.name: U8: Technical Dribbling
programs.description: Mastery of specific dribbling moves (scissors, step-overs) to beat defenders in 1v1 situations.

programs.name: U10: Physical Literacy
programs.description: General athletic development focused on speed, agility, and balance, minimizing risk of injury.

programs.name: U12: Positional Play (Rondo)
programs.description: Training concepts of possession, pressing triggers, and circulating the ball using Rondo drills.

programs.name: U14: Transitional Play
programs.description: Rapid transitions from defense to attack and vice versa, emphasizing quick decision-making and counter-attacking.

programs.name: U17: Mental Toughness
programs.description: Session dedicated to sports psychology, leadership, pressure management, and game focus.

programs.name: U6: Fun & Games
programs.description: A relaxed session focused purely on enjoying the game and basic motor skills development.

programs.name: Fitness & Injury Prevention
programs.description: Strength and conditioning program tailored for youth soccer players to build endurance and mobility.
